scientific.integrity: The asymptotic is derived directly from the published exact threshold sequence by a Taylor expansion with an analytic remainder, and the counting law follows from the published exact interval classification. A standalone numerical replay checks representative values but is not used to prove the limiting statements.
scientific.limitations: The result is restricted to the attractive golden-mean rectangular lattice and the positive-spectrum gap count of the cited theorem. It does not give individual gap widths, cover other irrational aspect ratios, or claim a convergent additive constant for the integer-valued gap count.

title: Geometric threshold accumulation and logarithmic gap-count divergence in the golden-mean Bethe–Sommerfeld lattice
